trigger: following the MFFP dataset date-label screen with no four-year candidates
selection: fixed two public RivTemp partners with catalog date extents exceeding four years: INRS and Vision H2O; choose all location identifiers, not based on target values, availability, quality or model outcomes
primary_screen: 2010-2020 distinct published ActivityStartDate labels; require four potentially complete years per station; labels alone are an optimistic necessary condition, not confirmed 24-hour quality
secondary_screen: full catalog years in each dataset as a separately reported retrospective sensitivity
before_date_screen: acquire both sources and freeze all station-location metadata; audit duplicate identities and coordinates across the MFFP and both new datasets
access_and_rights: read-only public download under provider terms; source files and any site-level derivative retained locally pending the apparent licence/disclaimer conflict
outcome: do not read source temperature values or score models until reference quality, clock, nonestimated status and prior hydrologic overlap are qualified; station repeats are not independent climates
interpretation: post-hoc selection of partners and exploratory availability screen; not preregistered independent confirmation or an unbiased sample of all monitoring networks
